props.label: Where our artists have played
props._notes: The client strip, the same block the other act pages carry.

props.html: The book is the blues and most of what the blues turned into. Freddie King and B.B. King sit at one end, The Cars, Prince and the rock records of the seventies and nineties at the other, and his own songs are threaded through. Guests recognize nearly all of it.
He’s a working Denver musician with his own catalog, his own site and his own channel, and he joined the roster under his own name in September 2026. The footage on this page is his.

rows.text: A fiftieth or a sixtieth for a crowd that grew up on these records, with a size that lets people talk over dinner and a size that fills a floor after it.

Classic rock fills a floor at a company party of every age, because the whole staff knows the songs whatever decade they grew up in. The four piece is the dance floor size, at a downtown Denver venue or your own office.
The evening after a day of sessions, on a deck or by a fire, with the acoustic end of his songbook played solo or as a duo.
The night before, and the hour after the ceremony, with solo voice and guitar under the conversation, for a couple who wants more grit in the music than a jazz set.

props.html: How the music sits around speeches and a program is planned with the run of show. What live music costs across Colorado, size by size, is set out in the cost guide.

props.html: Stage sizes and power for each size are on the technical page, and the questions every booking shares are on the full question list.

items.a: Blues and the rock and roll that came out of it, plus his own songs. The covers run from Freddie King and B.B. King through the classic rock of the seventies and the alternative rock of the nineties, and the footage on this page is him playing them. He's a Denver musician booked through Signet Artists, solo up to a four piece.

items.q: Will it fill a dance floor?
items.a: At trio and four piece, yes. It's voice and guitar over bass and drums, with a second guitar or keys on top at the four piece, playing blues and rock a crowd already knows.

Solo, it sits under the conversation, so a dinner table talks across it. The four piece on a dance floor plays like a rock band at a good party, and the band moves between the two on cue. He sets the level to the space and the crowd, and if your venue has a sound limit, give us the number.

items.q: Does he play originals at a private event?
items.a: Only if you want them. The default set for an event is covers, because guests dance to what they recognize. His own songs can sit inside the set where a night has space for them, which is worth asking about for a listening crowd.
